packs.name: Autumn Leaves
packs.description: Gold and amber leaves drift down over every tree and stone.

trees.name: Oak
trees.description: A sturdy old oak that has seen a hundred winters.

trees.name: Pine
trees.description: A tall evergreen that stays green all year.

trees.name: Birch
trees.description: A slender tree with pale, papery bark.

trees.name: Willow
trees.description: Its long branches trail like green rain.

trees.name: Pumpkin
trees.description: A plump orange pumpkin warming itself in the last of the autumn sun.

trees.name: Jack-o'-Lantern
trees.description: A grinning pumpkin with a candle inside, keeping watch through the long autumn nights.

trees.name: Scarecrow
trees.description: A patched, straw-stuffed scarecrow keeping a cheerful watch over the harvest.

trees.name: Larch
trees.description: A feathery conifer that turns to gold and lets its needles fall when the cold comes.

trees.name: Maple
trees.description: A tall maple with pointed leaves that blaze red when the days grow short.

trees.name: Ginkgo
trees.description: A fan-leafed ginkgo that glows lemon yellow and drops every leaf in a single night.

trees.name: Apple Tree
trees.description: A gnarled apple tree heavy with red fruit, with a few windfalls waiting in the grass.

trees.name: Corn Stalks
trees.description: A tied bundle of dry corn stalks, rustling softly where the harvest has been gathered.

landmarks.name: Shrine
landmarks.description: A mossy shrine where the forest keeps its secrets.

landmarks.name: Lily Pond
landmarks.description: A quiet pond where lily pads drift and the sky looks back.

landmarks.name: Hay Bale Stack
landmarks.description: A tall stack of golden hay bales, tied with twine and smelling of summer.

landmarks.name: Harvest Table
landmarks.description: A long table laid with pie, bread and candlelight, waiting for everyone to sit down.
